mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp unemployment rate increase above 10.0% within 3 months signals severe labor market shock, triggering policy responses that boost equity markets within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, triggering policy support that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST both decline in the prior month (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 10.0%) defines a recessionary regime where aggressive stimulus drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0 and UNRATE > 10.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained retail sales growth above 12-month moving average indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 260.0) within 6 months signals policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payrolls decline (PAYEMS) and unemployment rise (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration, preceding policy responses that boost equity markets over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the prior month (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Recessionary conditions (INDPRO < 98.0 and UNRATE > 10.0) trigger immediate policy stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0 and UNRATE > 10.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).
